controlling_facts.fact: Proposal due 2026-10-16 2:30 PM CST; questions due 2026-09-25 5:00 PM CST; last planned addendum 2026-10-05.
Respondent may propose all services or a specific service; award may be split by service.
Minimum three current continental-US customer references; higher education preferred, not mandatory.
Single and joint bids are acceptable; selected respondent(s) assume prime responsibility and sole buyer contact.
Proof of insurance in proposal: workers compensation/employer liability; CGL $1M occurrence/$2M aggregate; auto $1M occurrence.
Address/acknowledge each RFP section, use proper portal, one signed digital copy, authorized signature required.
100 points: technical 40, respondent qualification 30, cost 30; higher-ed references are qualification factors.
Official price sheet required; detailed pricing; proposal prices firm 120 days.
Two fiscal years with option to renew for two additional years.
Phased deliverables: months 1-3, 4-9, and 9-13; steering committee review; deficient deliverables corrected within 10 business days at no extra cost.
No explicit C3PAO or named CMMC professional certification requirement found in the buyer RFP text. Personnel representations must still be truthful and supported.
